<thought>We have retrieved polymorphs for 20 oxide compositions so far. To reach the required 40 compositions, we will first retrieve polymorphs for the next 10 compositions (TiO, V2O5, WO3, MoO3, ZrO2, HfO2, GeO2, In2O3, Ga2O3, Y2O3). After that, we will retrieve the final 10 compositions (La2O3, CeO2, Nd2O3, Sm2O3, Gd2O3, Ti3O5, SiO, Al2O5, FeO, Fe3O4). Once all 40 JSON files are present, we will list the directory to obtain all file paths, construct the required composition‑to‑file mapping, and use the consolidate_polymorph_datasets tool to merge them into a single dataset. The path to the consolidated JSON file will be returned as the final answer.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
  "compositions": ["TiO", "V2O5", "WO3", "MoO3", "ZrO2", "HfO2", "GeO2", "In2O3", "Ga2O3", "Y2O3"],
  "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
  "max_per_composition": 3,
  "save_directory": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/0_batch_retrieve_oxide_polymorphs_trial_12/oxide_polymorphs"
